_comment: C0-17 正文英译 · elevenlabs（2026-10-26）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（suno），related 写 1 条（frontmatter related 是 [gemini-chat]，键按正文链接行对齐=1）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 无「实测建议」段（能力口径以官方 changelog 为准），照源短译。

axes.model_access: Model iterations disclosed via the official changelog: Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo released (2026-09-28 entries), Scribe v2 Medical generally available (2026-09-11), music_v2_5 API support (2026-09-14) — direct-fetch verified 2026-10-21; the platform also aggregates third-party model configurations (changelog entries include gpt/claude-family LLM integrations).
axes.runtime: Web, API and mobile; generation processed in the cloud. The API is one of the main entry points for dubbing/voice product integration.
axes.local_files: Supports text, script and audio-material input (transcription, clone training); the material-processing stance is in the permissions axis.
axes.background: Generation is request-based; Agents/telephony products have persistent-session forms (changelog call-queueing and similar entries); no official statement of a "keep-running-after-shutdown" form.
axes.tools: Wide product surface: TTS, Voice Design/cloning, Speech to Text (Scribe line), Text to Dialogue, Conversational AI (phone/Widget), Workflows/Flows orchestration, audio effects (audio_effects 2026-10-12 entry).
axes.context: Generation is request-based, no cross-session conversation-memory form; voice assets (Voice Library/personal voices) are the persistence form.
axes.permissions: Official ToU §4(d) grants the platform a license to use content for operating and improving (including training); §4(i) provides a Data use settings menu to opt out of using content for training — self-service opt-out is rare in this category. Voice cloning requires the person's own consent or lawful authorization.
axes.fit: Teams making dubbing, audio content, voice products. Training opt-out is a self-service menu (relatively rare, worth calling out); get authorization before cloning someone else's voice — that is a personality-rights red line, not merely a terms question.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. Voice generation does not fit the coding test protocol; capability claims follow the official changelog.
unknowns:
- How models and quotas split across tiers (disclosed rolling via the changelog; this site has not verified tier by tier)
- Retention and deletion details for voice-clone training material (the ToU has no dedicated section verified item by item)
related: Also audio generation: the music-leaning contrast, with no opt-out option in its training license
